course_description: Together, this course and {{% resource_link "696ca855-56c8-4ceb-9052-72d0e124cdc7" "*8.06 Quantum Physics III*" %}} cover quantum physics with applications drawn from modern physics. Topics covered in this course include the general formalism of quantum mechanics, harmonic oscillator, quantum mechanics in three-dimensions, angular momentum, spin, and addition of angular momentum. The lectures and lecture notes for this course form the basis of Zwiebach’s textbook *Mastering Quantum Mechanics* published by {{% resource_link "024bcd28-285f-4bbe-9ed6-66eab75ada99" "MIT Press" %}} in April 2022.
